in_marathi.name: Adhiran
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adhiran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Adhiran is derived from the Sanskrit word 'adhi' meaning master or lord, and 'ran' meaning rule or control. This name is given to a child who is believed to have the intelligence and wisdom to rule or govern various aspects of life.
